title: This was a small group...
text:
This was a small group tour but it was just the 3 of us and we enjoyed the personal attention. 
Paula was very knowledgeable in all aspects of the Alhambra and Spanish history.
author: Susan_H

title: An amazing 3 hours!
text:
What a fantastic monument and a totally amazing tour. We took the 3 hour guided tour of the Alhambra and it was worth every penny! The tour was well constrcted and you were guided through with every step though of son things only got better and better.

The guide was knowlegable, fund and friendly and the tour wizzed by.
author: NWL72

title: An enlightening tour of Alhambra
text: We toured the Alhambra with Paula. She grew up in Granada. She told us interesting details about the history, architecture, restoration, culture, sultans, kings and queens of the Alhambra. The pace of the 3 hour tour was perfect.  We had time to absorb what we were seeing and feeling. We never felt rushed. She was great about answering our questions. Her English was exceptional and easy to understand, but charming with her Granada accent.
author: Debra_L

title: Excellent guided tour round a beautiful building.
text: We only booked this tour around 3 weeks beforehand and many were already fully booked. Luckily we found Lolita's Tours and our guide Paola. We were expecting a large group but it was only us and our very knowledgeable, enthusiastic and cheerful guide. She explained the history very clearly and so many interesting details that we would have. It was amazing how she maintained the same level of professionalism and enthusiasm over the 3 hour visit. It exceeded our expectations and Paola made it a perfect end to our holiday.
author: Julie H

title: A must visit UNESCO site in Granada
text:
Paula Fernandez from Lolita’s tours is the perfect tour guide for Alhambra.
She explained the history of Alhambra leading to a UNESCO site today. The sultans, kings, palaces, calligraphy, architecture and even Napoleon played a role. It is an interesting history but my brain cannot absorbed too much facts.
Those who like history, architecture, understanding of muslims and Christians influence will find the site very unique and interesting.
It is better to visit Alhambra with a  guide to appreciate the history.
author: Yap M

title: Great tour
text: We were very lucky to have a small group the day we did our tour with Paula. She is very knowledgeable and engaging. I had just had a great tour guide in Seville a couple of days before and didn't think I would be fortunate enough to get another that would compare byt Paula was more than up to providing a great 3 hour experience.

title: Exceptional
text: We have had a phenomenal experience, our tour guide “Carmela” was very impressed, she was so knowledgeable about everything, she was very patient and answered all the questions we asked, leaving behind a pleasant experience to go back. She is 100% recommended 😁

title: Palaces Nazaries: visit yes or yes
text: If you go to the Alhambra, hire a guide. We were lucky that only we participated in the tour, so it was a private tour with Laura, the guide. She explained to us in detail each site of the Alhambra. He also knew the symbolism of the Nazarite palaces.
